peoples.name: Humans
peoples.hint: Humans take the names of their region. Choose a homeland for a name of the tribes.
peoples.tagline: The many rivers: one folk in law and a hundred in custom.

blocks.text: **Creature Type:** Humanoid
**Size:** Medium (about 4 to 7 feet tall) or Small (about 2 to 4 feet tall), chosen when you select this species
**Speed:** 30 feet
As a human, you have these special traits.
**Resourceful.** You gain Heroic Inspiration whenever you finish a Long Rest.
**Skillful.** You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.
**Versatile.** You gain an Origin feat of your choice: one from the 2024 rules, or one from Part Four of this book.
Each current suggests a skill for Skillful and an Origin feat for Versatile, though any choice is open.

**The imperial-descended north** (the Frontier and the Heartland): ordered, formal, name-and-house folk who keep their history in stone and charter. Try History or Persuasion, and *Alert* or *Flag-Sworn*.

**The ancestral south** (the tribes and Confederacies): chant-keepers and story-tattooed lineages older than the Landing. Try Survival, Medicine, or Performance, and *The Spoken Line* or *Magic Initiate*.
**The cold-edge folk** (the whalers and hold-people of the deep south): blunt, superstitious, and tough as whale-leather. Try Athletics or Survival, and *Tough* or *Keeper of the Fire*.
*A General feat for level 4 or later, in place of another General feat.*
**Ability Score Increase.** Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20.
**Another Current.** You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.
**Second Fortune.** When you finish a Short Rest without Heroic Inspiration, you gain it. Once you gain Heroic Inspiration this way, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest.

peoples.name: Kalashtar
peoples.hint: Kalashtar keep their human names and families. The name they are given on the far shore is never shared.
peoples.tagline: Humans who began one night to dream the far shore, and kept its touch.

blocks.text: **Creature Type:** Humanoid
**Size:** Medium (about 4 to 7 feet tall) or Small (about 2 to 4 feet tall), chosen when you select this species
**Speed:** 30 feet
As a kalashtar, you have these special traits.
**Lit Eyes.** You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet. Your eyes keep a faint light in the dark, in the color of your season.

**The Voice Without Ears.** You can speak mind to mind with any creature you can see within 30 feet of you. You don't need to share a language with it, but it must understand at least one. It can answer you the same way until the end of your next turn. At character level 5 the range becomes 60 feet.
**Dreamer's Guard.** You have Resistance to Psychic damage, and you have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Charmed condition.
**Short Sleep.** You can finish a Long Rest in 4 hours if you spend those hours asleep, and you dream every one of them.
**The Draft.** You know when you are within 300 feet of a thin place, and in which direction it lies.
**Season of the Roam.** Choose the season you dream from the table below. Your eyes take its color. You know its cantrip, and you learn its spells at levels 3 and 5. (See Species spells.)
*A General feat for level 4 or later, in place of another General feat.*
**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
**Loud Mind.** When you use the Voice Without Ears, you can speak to a number of creatures equal to your Proficiency Bonus at once.

**Meet Me Out There.** When you finish a Long Rest, you can name one creature you have met that is on the same plane of existence. You find it on a road in the Roam: you each give the other a message of twenty-five words or fewer, which it remembers on waking or receives at once as a daydream. An unwilling creature can refuse to hear you.
**A Second Season.** Choose a second season from your Season of the Roam trait. You learn its cantrip and the spell it grants at level 3, which you can cast once without a spell slot per Long Rest.

peoples.name: Shifters
peoples.hint: Shifters are born into ordinary families and carry the names of their region. A shifter of the tribes carries the tribe: choose a homeland.
peoples.tagline: Born with a beast in the blood: a tail, fangs, a ridge of pelt, and a short while each day when the beast comes up.

blocks.text: **Creature Type:** Humanoid
**Size:** Medium (about 4 to 7 feet tall) or Small (about 2 to 4 feet tall), chosen when you select this species
**Speed:** 30 feet
As a shifter, you have these special traits.
**The Marks.** Choose two marks the beast left on you. You have them always.
**Lamp-eyes.** You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.
**Turning ears.** You gain proficiency in the Perception skill.
**Hound's nose.** You have Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) and Wisdom (Survival) checks that rely on smell.
**Tail.** You have Advantage on ability checks and saving throws you make to keep your footing or avoid the Prone condition, and your tail can hold an object that weighs 5 pounds or less.
**Claws.** You have a Climb Speed equal to your Speed.

**Fangs.** You can use your fangs to make Unarmed Strikes. When you hit with them, the strike deals 1d6 + your Strength modifier Piercing damage, instead of the Bludgeoning damage normal for an Unarmed Strike.
**Pelt.** You suffer no hardship from extreme cold, and you have Advantage on saving throws against weather and exposure.

**Shifting.** As a Bonus Action, you let the beast up. The shift lasts 1 minute, or until you die or end it (no action required). When you shift, you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to 2 times your Proficiency Bonus, and you gain the benefit of what the beast gave you (below). You can shift a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all uses when you finish a Long Rest.
**What the Beast Gave.** Choose one. It applies while you are shifted.
**Tooth.** When you shift, and as a Bonus Action on your later turns, you can make one Unarmed Strike with your teeth. It deals 1d6 + your Strength modifier Piercing damage.
**Stride.** Your Speed increases by 10 feet, and your movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks from a creature you have attacked this turn.
**Hide.** You gain 1d6 additional Temporary Hit Points when you shift, and a +1 bonus to Armor Class while you have any of them.
**Sense.** You have Advantage on Wisdom checks, and no creature within 30 feet of you can have Advantage on an attack roll against you unless you have the Incapacitated condition.
**The Blood Knows.** You have Advantage on Wisdom (Insight) and Wisdom (Survival) checks you make to read the mood of a Beast or Monstrosity or to follow its trail.
*A General feat for level 4 or later, in place of another General feat.*
**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
**A Third Mark.** Choose one more of the Marks from your Shifter traits.
**Quick Rising.** When you roll Initiative, you can shift as part of the roll, with no action required.

peoples.name: Half-elves
peoples.hint: Half-elves draw from either parent's convention, and often both at once.
peoples.tagline: The bridge-folk: brokers, translators, captains, and go-betweens, welcome at two tables and fluent in the silences of each.

blocks.text: **Creature Type:** Humanoid
**Size:** Medium (about 5 to 6 feet tall)
**Speed:** 30 feet
As a half-elf, you have these special traits.
**Darkvision.** You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.
**Fey Ancestry.** You have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Charmed condition.
**Bridge-Born.** You gain proficiency in two skills of your choice, and you learn one extra language.

**Factor's Ear.** When you make a Wisdom (Insight) or Charisma (Persuasion) check, you can give yourself Advantage on the roll; decide before you roll. You can do this a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all uses when you finish a Long Rest.
*A General feat for level 4 or later, in place of another General feat.*
**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Wisdom or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
**Polyglot.** You learn two languages.
**Both Faces.** Your Factor's Ear also works on Charisma (Deception) and Charisma (Intimidation) checks.
**Common Ground.** You can cast *Calm Emotions* once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to do so when you finish a Long Rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for it.

peoples.name: Elves
peoples.hint: Four kinds of elf name four ways. The region picks the kind: High in the Heartland, Sunwood in the south, Frost on the ice, Wood everywhere else.
peoples.tagline: Four kinds of elf on the surface, all honoring many-aspected Aelthuvar and the Exodus through Castia, and a fifth kind below.

blocks.text: **Creature Type:** Humanoid
**Size:** Medium (about 5 to 6 feet tall)
**Speed:** 30 feet
As an elf, you have these special traits.
**Darkvision.** You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.
**Elven Lineage.** Choose your kind of elf from the table below. You gain its level 1 benefit, and you learn its spells at levels 3 and 5. (See Species spells.)

rows: You know the *Prestidigitation* cantrip. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can replace it with another cantrip from the Wizard spell list.
Your Speed increases to 35 feet, and you know the *Druidcraft* cantrip.
You know the *Guidance* cantrip, and you learn one extra language: Confederacy speech or Sylvan.
You know the *Ray of Frost* cantrip, and you suffer no hardship from extreme cold.
Your Darkvision's range increases to 120 feet, and you know the *Dancing Lights* cantrip.

blocks.text: **Fey Ancestry.** You have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Charmed condition.
**Keen Senses.** You have proficiency in the Insight, Perception, or Survival skill (your choice).
**Trance.** You don't need to sleep, and magic can't put you to sleep. You can finish a Long Rest in 4 hours if you spend those hours in a trancelike meditation, during which you stay conscious.
*A General feat for level 4 or later, in place of another General feat.*
**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Dexterity, Intelligence, or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
**Centuries of Practice.** You gain proficiency in one skill or with one tool of your choice.
**Deep Lineage.** You can cast each of the level 3 and level 5 spells of your Elven Lineage one more time without a spell slot before you finish a Long Rest.

peoples.name: Aethyn
peoples.hint: Airy, gliding names. The eyrie stands in place of a family name.
peoples.tagline: Lean, light-boned skykin of Highspire and the high sea-stacks, whose flight waxes and wanes with the two moons.

blocks.text: **Creature Type:** Humanoid
**Size:** Medium (about 5 to 6 feet tall, with a wingspan twice that)
**Speed:** 30 feet
As an Aethyn, you have these special traits.
**Darkvision.** You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet. The Aethyn are a night-leaning people, most alive under the moons.

**Gliding Wings.** You have feathered wings. When you fall and aren't Incapacitated, you can spread them: you descend at 60 feet per round, take no damage from the fall, and can move up to 2 feet horizontally for every 1 foot you descend. Gliding costs no movement. A jump isn't a fall unless it carries you over an edge. You can't glide while wearing Heavy armor.
**Skyborn Eyes.** You have proficiency in the Perception skill, and you have Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight to spot something at least 300 feet away.
**Star-Reader.** You always know which way is north, the hour of the night, and the phase of both moons, and you can't become lost while you can see the sky.

**Moon-Tide Flight (Level 5).** As a Bonus Action, you can take wing. For 10 minutes you have a Fly Speed equal to your Speed. Each time you take off during those 10 minutes, you must either start from a height of at least 10 feet or spend all your movement that turn launching from level ground; landing doesn't end the trait. You can't use this trait while wearing Medium or Heavy armor. Once you use it, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.
**High Tide.** On a night when both moons are full, the flight lasts 1 hour.
**Slack Tide.** On a night when neither moon is in the sky, the flight lasts only 1 minute.
**King Tide.** On the Three Nights of a King Tide, you can use this trait without expending its use.
*A General feat for level 4 or later, in place of another General feat.*
**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Dexterity or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
**Updraft.** Once you have Moon-Tide Flight, taking off from level ground costs you only half your movement.
**Wind-Wise.** Once you have Moon-Tide Flight, you can use it twice before you finish a Long Rest.

**Stooping Dive.** Once per turn, when you descend at least 30 feet vertically while flying or gliding and then hit a creature with a melee attack on the same turn, the attack deals an extra 1d8 damage.

peoples.name: Cindren
peoples.hint: Short, crackling names, with a hearth-surname.
peoples.tagline: Forge-folk of Everfall with skin like banked coals, whose feelings show as light beneath the skin.

blocks.text: **Creature Type:** Humanoid
**Size:** Medium (about 5 to 6½ feet tall)
**Speed:** 30 feet
As a Cindren, you have these special traits.
**Darkvision.** You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

**Fire-Hearted.** You have Resistance to Fire damage, and you can handle hot metal, coals, and molten glass without harm for up to a minute at a time. This covers ordinary heat only, not magic such as *Heat Metal*.

**Ember-Lines.** Your ember-lines shed Dim Light in a 5-foot radius when you are angry, afraid, in love, or in pain. As a Bonus Action you can flare them to shed Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for 10 feet beyond that, or bank them dark. Banked lines flare back to Dim Light whenever you take damage.
**Forge-Kin.** You have proficiency with your choice of Smith's Tools or Glassblower's Tools.
**Cinder Magic.** You know the *Produce Flame* cantrip. At level 3 you learn *Burning Hands*, and at level 5 you learn *Heat Metal*. (See Species spells.)
*A General feat for level 4 or later, in place of another General feat.*
**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Constitution or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
**Searing Magic.** Fire damage you deal with spells ignores Resistance to Fire damage.

**Forge-Fed.** When you take Fire damage from a source other than yourself and aren't reduced to 0 Hit Points by it, you can take a Reaction to regain Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all uses when you finish a Long Rest.
**Ember Control.** Your Ember-Lines no longer flare when you take damage. They glow only when you let them.

peoples.name: Coral peoples
peoples.hint: Flowing, resonant names. The court stands in place of a surname.
peoples.tagline: The merfolk and their kin of the deep courts, whose amphibious shore-lines walk the dry world as pact-wardens, pearl-factors, and tide-pilots.

blocks.text: **Creature Type:** Humanoid
**Size:** Medium (about 5 to 6 feet tall)
**Speed:** 30 feet, and a Swim Speed of 30 feet
As one of the coral peoples, you have these special traits.
**Amphibious.** You can breathe air and water.
**Darkvision.** You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.
**Child of the Deep.** You have Resistance to Cold damage, and you ignore the effects of the cold and pressure of deep water.
**Speaker to the Sea.** You can communicate simple ideas to any Beast, Elemental, or Monstrosity that has a Swim Speed, and it can understand you. You understand it in return.
**Court-Born.** You are of one of the deep courts. Choose it from the table below. You know its cantrip, and you learn its spells at levels 3 and 5. (See Species spells.)

rows: **The Glass Gardens** (fair merfolk; living reef; memory-pearls)

blocks.text: *A General feat for level 4 or later, in place of another General feat.*
**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Wisdom or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
**Strong Swimmer.** Your Swim Speed increases by 10 feet.

**Breath for Others.** You always have *Water Breathing* prepared, and you can cast it only as a Ritual, without material components. When you cast it this way, it affects you and up to a number of creatures equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Your Court-Born spellcasting ability is your spellcasting ability for it.
**Gift of Song.** You have Advantage on Charisma checks you make with the sea-folk of any court.

peoples.name: Dragonborn
peoples.hint: Clan comes before self in importance.
peoples.tagline: The mainland scale-folk: refugees, exiles, and traders of the long war, imperial in bearing and iron once sworn.

blocks.text: **Creature Type:** Humanoid
**Size:** Medium (about 5 to 7 feet tall)
**Speed:** 30 feet
As a dragonborn, you have these special traits.
**Draconic Ancestry.** Your clan's blood comes from one kind of dragon. Choose it from the table below; it sets the damage type of your Breath Weapon and your Damage Resistance.

**Breath Weapon.** When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can replace one of your attacks with an exhalation of magical energy, either a 15-foot Cone or a 30-foot Line 5 feet wide (your choice each time). Each creature in the area makes a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 + your Constitution modifier + your Proficiency Bonus). On a failed save, a creature takes 1d10 damage of your ancestry's type, or half as much on a success. The damage becomes 2d10 at level 5, 3d10 at level 11, and 4d10 at level 17. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all uses when you finish a Long Rest.
**Damage Resistance.** You have Resistance to the damage type of your ancestry.
**Darkvision.** You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

**Draconic Flight (Level 5).** As a Bonus Action, you sprout spectral wings for 10 minutes, or until you dismiss them (no action required) or have the Incapacitated condition. While they last, you have a Fly Speed equal to your Speed. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.
*A General feat for level 4 or later, in place of another General feat.*
**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Strength, Constitution, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
**Breath of the Clan.** Your Breath Weapon's damage dice become d12s.

**Dragon's Roar.** When you would use your Breath Weapon, you can roar instead. Each creature of your choice within 30 feet of you that can hear you must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 + your Charisma modifier + your Proficiency Bonus) or have the Frightened condition until the end of your next turn. This expends a use of your Breath Weapon.

peoples.name: Dwarves
peoples.hint: Each family name is a hall's name, and some of those halls fell.
peoples.tagline: Master crafters of hold and harbor who keep the Tally: the eternal ledger of every debt, favor, and grudge.

blocks.text: **Creature Type:** Humanoid
**Size:** Medium (about 4 to 5 feet tall)
**Speed:** 30 feet
As a dwarf, you have these special traits.
**Darkvision.** You have Darkvision with a range of 120 feet.
**Dwarven Resilience.** You have Resistance to Poison damage, and you have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Poisoned condition.
**Dwarven Toughness.** Your Hit Point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 again whenever you gain a level.

**Stonecunning.** As a Bonus Action, you gain Tremorsense with a range of 60 feet for 10 minutes. You must be on a stone surface or touching one to use it. You can use this Bonus Action a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all uses when you finish a Long Rest.
*A General feat for level 4 or later, in place of another General feat.*
**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Constitution or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Entered in the Tally.** When a creature you can see deals damage to you, it is *entered* until the end of your next turn. Once per turn, when you hit an entered creature with an attack, you can deal extra damage to it equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
**Debts Kept.** You can recall exactly every debt, favor, and promise made to you or by you.

peoples.name: Galven
peoples.hint: A short given name, and the storm-name of the squall you were born under.
peoples.tagline: Blue-skinned storm-folk with lightning in the blood, whose marks blaze brighter as their feelings rise.

blocks.text: **Creature Type:** Humanoid
**Size:** Medium (about 5½ to 6½ feet tall)
**Speed:** 30 feet
As a Galven, you have these special traits.
**Storm-Blooded.** You have Resistance to Lightning damage.
**Storm-Eyes.** You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet. Your eyes glow faintly in the dark, amber, gold, or storm-white.
**Living Charge.** You know the *Shocking Grasp* cantrip. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for it (choose when you select this species).

**Weather in the Bones.** You always know what the weather will do in your area over the next 24 hours, and you know an hour in advance when a natural storm, squall, or lightning will strike within a mile of you. You also have proficiency with Navigator's Tools.

**Storm Flare (Level 3).** As a Bonus Action, you let your charge climb. For 1 minute, your marks blaze white, shedding Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for 10 feet beyond, and once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with an attack or damage it with a spell, you can deal extra Lightning damage to it equal to your Proficiency Bonus. While the flare lasts, a creature that hits you with a melee attack while within 5 feet of you takes Lightning damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.
*A General feat for level 4 or later, in place of another General feat.*
**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Dexterity, Constitution, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
**Still Marks.** You can dim the glow of your marks and eyes at will, and you have Advantage on Charisma (Deception) checks you make to hide what you feel.
**Twice the Storm.** You can use Storm Flare twice before you finish a Long Rest.

peoples.name: Gnomes
peoples.hint: Quick, doubled sounds, with a workshop-surname.
peoples.tagline: The sparkfolk: tinkers, lens-grinders, clockwrights, and problem-worriers who keep Tik, the Tinkering Spark.

blocks.text: **Creature Type:** Humanoid
**Size:** Small (about 3 to 4 feet tall)
**Speed:** 30 feet
As a gnome, you have these special traits.
**Darkvision.** You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.
**Gnomish Cunning.** You have Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.
**Gnomish Lineage.** Choose one of these lineages. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for its spells (choose when you select the lineage).

**Workshop Gnome** (the Rock Gnome of the 2024 rules): you know the *Mending* and *Prestidigitation* cantrips. You can spend 10 minutes casting *Prestidigitation* to create a Tiny clockwork device (AC 5, 1 Hit Point), such as a toy, a fire starter, or a music box. When you make it, you choose one effect of *Prestidigitation* it can produce (if the effect offers a choice, the device produces only the option you chose); a creature can take a Bonus Action to activate it by touch. You can have up to three such devices at a time, and each falls apart 8 hours after you make it or when you take it apart with a touch (a Utilize action).

**Green-Edge Gnome** (the Forest Gnome of the 2024 rules): you know the *Minor Illusion* cantrip, and you always have *Speak with Animals* prepared. You can cast it without a spell slot a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, regaining all uses when you finish a Long Rest, and you can cast it with any spell slots you have.
*A General feat for level 4 or later, in place of another General feat.*
**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Intelligence or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
**Tinker's Eye.** You always have *Identify* prepared, and you can cast it as a Ritual without its material component. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for it.
**Workshop Hands.** When you make an ability check using Artisan's Tools (Tinker's Tools included), you can roll 1d4 and add it to the check.

**Lineage Spark.** If you are a Workshop Gnome, you can have up to five clockwork devices at a time. If you are a Green-Edge Gnome, a single casting of your *Minor Illusion* can create both a sound and an image.

peoples.name: Goblinoids
peoples.hint: Quick, sharp names. Epithets are earned, never inherited.
peoples.tagline: The Skarn's children: goblins, hobgoblins, and bugbears, who hold that the small and clever outlast the great and proud.

blocks.text: **Creature Type:** Humanoid
**Size:** Small (goblin) or Medium (hobgoblin, bugbear), chosen with your kin
**Speed:** 30 feet
As a goblinoid, you have these special traits.
**Darkvision.** You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.
**Salvager.** You have proficiency with Tinker's Tools, and you can judge the worth and the origin of a piece of salvage by handling it for a minute.
**Survivor's Creed.** You have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Charmed condition.
**Goblinoid Kin.** Choose your kin. You gain its traits.

**Goblin (Small).** *Nimble Escape:* you can take the Disengage or Hide action as a Bonus Action. *Fury of the Small:* once per turn, when you hit a creature larger than you, you can deal extra damage to it equal to your Proficiency Bonus; you can do this a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all uses when you finish a Long Rest.

**Hobgoblin (Medium).** *Fortune from the Many:* when you miss with an attack roll or fail an ability check or saving throw, you can add a bonus to the roll equal to the number of allies you can see within 30 feet of you (maximum +3). *Shoulder to Shoulder:* you can take the Help action as a Bonus Action. Each of these has its own uses: you can use each one a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all uses of both when you finish a Long Rest.

**Bugbear (Medium).** *Long-Limbed:* when you make a melee attack on your turn, your reach for it is 5 feet greater. *Ambusher:* when you hit a creature that hasn't yet taken a turn in the current combat, the attack deals an extra 2d6 damage, once per combat. *Big Frame:* you count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity.
*A General feat for level 4 or later, in place of another General feat.*
**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Dexterity, Constitution, or Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
**Beneath Notice.** Creatures larger than you have Disadvantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks they make against you.
**Slip Away.** When a creature larger than you misses you with an attack, you can take a Reaction to move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

peoples.name: Goliaths
peoples.hint: Weighty names, with a deed-name added for a great feat.
peoples.tagline: Towering, stone-skinned clanfolk of the great peaks, cousins-in-faith to the Vorthani, who score every feat.

blocks.text: **Creature Type:** Humanoid
**Size:** Medium (about 7 to 8 feet tall)
**Speed:** 35 feet
As a goliath, you have these special traits.
**Giant Ancestry.** Choose one of these giant ancestries. You can use its benefit a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all uses when you finish a Long Rest.
**Cloud's Jaunt.** As a Bonus Action, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.
**Fire's Burn.** When you hit a target with an attack roll and deal damage to it, you can also deal 1d10 Fire damage to it.
**Frost's Chill.** When you hit a target with an attack roll and deal damage to it, you can also deal 1d6 Cold damage to it and reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.
**Hill's Tumble.** When you hit a Large or smaller creature with an attack roll and deal damage to it, you can give it the Prone condition.
**Stone's Endurance.** When you take damage, you can take a Reaction to roll 1d12, add your Constitution modifier, and reduce the damage by the total.
**Storm's Thunder.** When a creature within 60 feet of you deals damage to you, you can take a Reaction to deal 1d8 Thunder damage to it.

**Large Form (Level 5).** As a Bonus Action, you become Large for 10 minutes or until you end it (no action required), if there is room. While Large, you have Advantage on Strength checks and your Speed increases by 10 feet. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.
**Powerful Build.** You have Advantage on any ability check you make to end the Grappled condition, and you count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity.
*A General feat for level 4 or later, in place of another General feat.*
**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Strength or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
**One More Feat.** You can use your Giant Ancestry one more time before you finish a Long Rest, and you can use Large Form twice before you finish a Long Rest.
**Great Reach.** While your Large Form is active, your reach is 5 feet greater.

peoples.name: Halflings
peoples.hint: Homely names, with surnames of hearth and hedge.
peoples.tagline: The good quiet life: innkeepers, cooks, road-folk, and river-pilots who keep Penny Greenstep.

blocks.text: **Creature Type:** Humanoid
**Size:** Small (about 2 to 3 feet tall)
**Speed:** 30 feet
As a halfling, you have these special traits.
**Brave.** You have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Frightened condition.
**Halfling Nimbleness.** You can move through the space of any creature that is a size larger than you, but you can't stop in the same space.
**Luck.** When you roll a 1 on the d20 of a D20 Test, you can reroll the die, and you must use the new roll.
**Naturally Stealthy.** You can take the Hide action even when you are obscured only by a creature that is at least one size larger than you.
*A General feat for level 4 or later, in place of another General feat.*
**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Dexterity, Constitution, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Shared Luck.** When an ally you can see within 30 feet of you rolls a 1 on the d20 for a D20 Test, you can take a Reaction to let them reroll the die; they must use the new roll. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all uses when you finish a Long Rest.
**Back to the Stew.** Allies within 10 feet of you have Advantage on saving throws they make to avoid or end the Frightened condition. *(Halflings are steadiest when the roof actually falls in.)*

peoples.name: Kobolds
peoples.hint: Clicked, quick names. The warren is shared as a family name.
peoples.tagline: The Underscale's own: small, scaled, trap-clever, and unkillable as a rumor.

blocks.text: **Creature Type:** Humanoid
**Size:** Small (about 2 to 3 feet tall)
**Speed:** 30 feet
As a kobold, you have these special traits.
**Darkvision.** You have Darkvision with a range of 120 feet.

**Underscale Cry.** As a Bonus Action, you give a piercing cry. Until the start of your next turn, you and your allies have Advantage on attack rolls against any enemy that was within 10 feet of you and could hear you when you cried out. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all uses when you finish a Long Rest.

**Warren-Clever.** You gain proficiency in one of these skills: Investigation, Sleight of Hand, Stealth, or Survival. You also gain proficiency with one of these tools: Mason's Tools, Thieves' Tools, or Tinker's Tools.

**Nothing Wasted.** When you finish a Short or Long Rest, you can turn scrap and salvage into one piece of Adventuring Gear worth no more than 1 Anchor (1 GP), such as a bag of caltrops, a pouch of ball bearings, a 10-foot pole, a few pitons, or 50 feet of hempen rope. It lasts until you use it up or until you make another item with this trait.
*A General feat for level 4 or later, in place of another General feat.*
**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Dexterity or Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
**Better Salvage.** Your Nothing Wasted trait can make items worth up to 10 Anchors (10 GP), such as a Healer's Kit, a Hunting Trap, or a Hooded Lantern, and you can keep two such items at a time.

**Quick Traps.** You can set a Hunting Trap, or scatter caltrops or ball bearings, as a Bonus Action. Any saving throw against them uses your DC (8 + your Intelligence modifier + your Proficiency Bonus) if it is higher.

peoples.name: Liriath
peoples.hint: Soft green breaths, kept for a season or a century.
peoples.tagline: Walking green life of the deep jungle: patient, rooted, long-memoried, and the sharpest grief in the south.

blocks.text: **Creature Type:** Humanoid
**Size:** Medium (about 4½ to 7 feet tall) or Small (about 3 to 4 feet tall), chosen when you select this species; tree-kin are always Medium
**Speed:** 30 feet
As a Liriath, you have these special traits.
**Green Body.** You can eat as other peoples do, or sustain yourself on water and an hour of daylight instead of food.

**Sap and Sun.** Your wounds close over with new growth. When you spend Hit Point Dice during a Short Rest in daylight (an overcast sky counts; moonlight and lamplight don't), add your Proficiency Bonus to each die you roll.
**Grove-Speaker.** You know the *Druidcraft* cantrip.
**Liriath Kind.** What grows in you shapes you. Choose your kind from the table below; you gain its benefit at level 1 and learn its spells at levels 3 and 5. (See Species spells.)

rows: **Bark Body.** When you aren't wearing armor, your base Armor Class is 13 + your Dexterity modifier. You can use a Shield and keep this benefit.
You know the *Thorn Whip* cantrip, and your Speed increases to 35 feet.
**Fern- and moss-kin** (quiet keepers of the deep dark)
You know the *Poison Spray* cantrip, and you have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

blocks.text: *A General feat for level 4 or later, in place of another General feat.*
**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Constitution or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Take Root.** As a Bonus Action while standing on natural ground (soil, sand, or living wood; a ship's deck doesn't count), you root yourself for up to 1 minute. Until the minute ends or you move or are moved, your Speed is 0, you have Advantage on saving throws against effects that would push, pull, or knock you Prone, and at the start of each of your turns, if you are in daylight and Bloodied (at half your Hit Points or fewer) but have at least 1 Hit Point, you regain Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all uses when you finish a Long Rest.

peoples.name: Florians
peoples.hint: A Florian takes a day-name for its single bright day.

blocks.text: Florians are the Liriath's tiny, wholly floral cousins, who live a single day and know nothing of time. They are a wonder of the world, not a player species. If a player and the GM want one anyway, the story has to answer one question first: **a grove's deep blessing, or some magic, has stretched this Florian's bloom.**
**Rules:** use the Liriath traits with **bloom-kin**. A Florian is far smaller than most Small creatures (knee-high at most), but for the rules it is **Small**.
**Living in the now.** The Florian has no sense of past or future. They have Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Frightened condition.
**The bloom.** The GM decides how long the blessing lasts, and what it would take to keep it. That question is the character's arc.

peoples.name: Lizardfolk
peoples.hint: Sibilant names. Tribe-names are names of water.
peoples.tagline: The cold-blooded pragmatists of swamp and shore: dependable within a bargain's exact words, and only its exact words.

blocks.text: **Creature Type:** Humanoid
**Size:** Medium (about 5 to 7 feet tall)
**Speed:** 30 feet, and a Swim Speed of 30 feet
As one of the lizardfolk, you have these special traits.

**Bite.** You can use your fanged maw to make Unarmed Strikes. When you hit with it, the strike deals 1d6 + your Strength modifier Piercing damage, instead of the Bludgeoning damage normal for an Unarmed Strike.
**Hold Breath.** You can hold your breath for up to 15 minutes at a time.
**Natural Armor.** When you aren't wearing armor, your base Armor Class is 13 + your Dexterity modifier. You can use a Shield and keep this benefit.

**Hungry Jaws.** As a Bonus Action, you can make a special attack with your Bite. If it hits, it deals its normal damage and you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all uses when you finish a Long Rest.
**Mud-Reader.** You gain proficiency in two of these skills: Animal Handling, Medicine, Nature, Perception, Stealth, or Survival.
*A General feat for level 4 or later, in place of another General feat.*
**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Strength, Constitution, or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
**Bigger Bite.** Your Bite deals 1d8 Piercing damage instead of 1d6.

**Clamp.** Once per turn, when you hit a creature with your Bite on your turn, you can also try to grapple it if it is no more than one size larger than you: it must succeed on a Strength or Dexterity saving throw (its choice; DC 8 + your Strength modifier + your Proficiency Bonus) or have the Grappled condition, with the same escape DC. While you grapple a creature this way, you can't Bite another creature.

peoples.name: The Marked
peoples.hint: A quiet family name kept close, and often a chosen name held like a vow.
peoples.tagline: Aasimar and tieflings: the peoples who wear their heritage on the skin, and answered fear with wit, discretion, and iron mutual aid.

blocks.text: **Creature Type:** Humanoid
**Size:** Medium (about 4 to 7 feet tall) or Small (about 2 to 4 feet tall), chosen when you select this species
**Speed:** 30 feet
**Celestial Resistance.** Resistance to Necrotic and Radiant damage.
**Darkvision.** 60 feet.
**Healing Hands.** Once per Long Rest, a touch that heals a number of d4s equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
**Light Bearer.** You know the *Light* cantrip.
**Celestial Revelation (Level 3).** Once per Long Rest, a one-minute transformation: spectral wings and flight, a searing radiance, or a frightening shroud, with a little extra damage once a turn.
*Short form. The full wording is in the 2024 rules.*
**Creature Type:** Humanoid
**Size:** Medium (about 4 to 7 feet tall) or Small (about 3 to 4 feet tall), chosen when you select this species
**Speed:** 30 feet
As a tiefling, you have these special traits.
**Darkvision.** You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.
**Fiendish Legacy.** Choose a legacy from the table below. You gain its level 1 benefit, and you learn its spells at levels 3 and 5. (See Species spells.)
**Otherworldly Presence.** You know the *Thaumaturgy* cantrip, using the same spellcasting ability as your legacy.

rows: The daemon-blood of the drowned Orka empire
The cold line of the drowned and the kept dead
Old pacts sworn in fire, like the one House Alastor does not speak of

blocks.text: *A General feat for level 4 or later, in place of another General feat.*
**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Speak Your Name.** When you fail a Wisdom or Charisma saving throw, you can speak or silently mouth your chosen name and reroll the save; you must use the new roll. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.
**The Marked Door.** In any settlement with Marked residents, you can find shelter, a meal, and a quiet word.

peoples.name: Orcs and half-orcs
peoples.hint: The Telling grants a deed-name.
peoples.tagline: Heirs of the fallen empire: descendants of the Orka, who keep the Tusk-Marking and the Telling.

blocks.text: **Creature Type:** Humanoid
**Size:** Medium (about 6 to 7 feet tall)
**Speed:** 30 feet
As an orc, you have these special traits.

**Adrenaline Rush.** You can take the Dash action as a Bonus Action. When you do, you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all uses when you finish a Short or Long Rest.
**Darkvision.** You have Darkvision with a range of 120 feet.

**Relentless Endurance.** When you are reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 Hit Point instead. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.
*A General feat for level 4 or later, in place of another General feat.*
**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Strength or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
**Unbroken Line.** You regain the use of Relentless Endurance when you finish a Short or Long Rest.
**Warning Carried.** When you use Adrenaline Rush, you can also end the Frightened condition on yourself.
**Know the Fall.** You have Advantage on Intelligence (History) checks about the Orka.

blocks.text: **Creature Type:** Humanoid
**Size:** Small (about 2½ to 3½ feet tall)
**Speed:** 30 feet
As a Pocchin, you have these special traits.

**Nose for Value.** By handling an object for 1 minute, you learn its market value to within a tenth, whether a coin, gem, document, or work of art is genuine, and whether the object is magical (but not what its magic does).

**The Fat Offer.** You have proficiency in the Persuasion skill. When you make a Charisma check as part of a bargain or a haggle, you can give yourself Advantage on the roll; decide before you roll. You can do this a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all uses when you finish a Long Rest.

**Don't Mistake Us for Soft.** When a creature within 5 feet of you deals damage to you, you can take a Reaction to make one Unarmed Strike against it, using the Damage option: teeth, claws, and a great deal of fury. It deals 1d4 + your Strength modifier Bludgeoning or Piercing damage (your choice). You can use this trait a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all uses when you finish a Long Rest.
**Absurdly Fluffy.** You take half damage from falling, and you are comfortable in cold weather without cold-weather gear.
*A General feat for level 4 or later, in place of another General feat.*
**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Charisma or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**The Aria.** As a Bonus Action, you bellow your titles. Up to a number of creatures equal to your Proficiency Bonus that you choose within 30 feet of you and that can hear you must each succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 + your Charisma modifier + your Proficiency Bonus) or have Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the start of your next turn. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all uses when you finish a Long Rest.
**Hoard-Keeper.** You have Advantage on ability checks and saving throws you make to keep hold of an object you are carrying.

peoples.name: Sporrn
peoples.hint: Soft, humming tones, styled by place in the colony.
peoples.tagline: Pale, soft, fungal folk of the deep caves and the drowned Orka undercities, who breathe and speak in spores.

blocks.text: **Creature Type:** Humanoid
**Size:** Medium (about 4½ to 6 feet tall)
**Speed:** 30 feet
As a Sporrn, you have these special traits.
**Darkvision.** You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.
**Fungal Body.** You have Resistance to Poison damage, and you have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Poisoned condition.

**Spore-Speech.** You can speak telepathically to any creature you can see within 30 feet of you that breathes. You don't need to share a language for it to understand your meaning, but it must understand at least one language, and it can't answer you this way. Spore-speech passes through a veil, but not through a solid barrier or underwater.
**Deep Pharmacy.** You have proficiency with the Herbalism Kit and the Poisoner's Kit.
**Healer or Horror.** Choose which spores you share. You know the cantrip and learn the spells at levels 3 and 5. (See Species spells.)
*A General feat for level 4 or later, in place of another General feat.*
**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Wisdom or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
**Two-Way Spores.** The range of your Spore-Speech becomes 60 feet, and a creature you speak to this way can answer you telepathically.

**Spore-Link.** As a Magic action, you link up to a number of willing creatures equal to your Proficiency Bonus that you can see within 30 feet of you. For 1 hour, linked creatures (you included) can speak telepathically to one another while within 120 feet of each other. Once made, the link works through barriers and underwater. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

peoples.name: Tarvan
peoples.hint: The clan-name is set before the given name.
peoples.tagline: The horned clans of the high moors: gentle giants, cattle-folk in truth, and masters of combat as an art.

blocks.text: **Creature Type:** Humanoid
**Size:** Medium (about 7 to 8 feet tall; clan champions taller still)
**Speed:** 30 feet
As a Tarvan, you have these special traits.

**Horns.** You can use your horns to make Unarmed Strikes. When you hit with them, the strike deals 1d6 + your Strength modifier Piercing damage, instead of the Bludgeoning damage normal for an Unarmed Strike. When you use an Unarmed Strike to Shove a creature, you can push it up to 10 feet instead of 5.
**Powerful Build.** You have Advantage on any ability check you make to end the Grappled condition, and you count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity.
**Highland Hide.** You have Resistance to Cold damage, and you suffer no hardship from extreme cold, wind, or rain.
**Hard to Move.** You have Advantage on saving throws against effects that would push, pull, or knock you Prone. (Forced movement that allows no save still moves you.)
**Herd-Kin.** You have Advantage on Wisdom (Animal Handling) checks with Beasts that graze in herds, such as cattle, horses, aurocs, and saurian grazers.

**Stampede.** Once per turn, when you move at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hit it with a melee attack on the same turn, the attack deals an extra 1d8 damage of its type. If the creature is no more than one size larger than you, it must also succeed on a Strength saving throw (DC 8 + your Strength modifier + your Proficiency Bonus) or have the Prone condition. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all uses when you finish a Long Rest.
*A General feat for level 4 or later, in place of another General feat.*
**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Strength or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Weapon-Forms.** When you roll a 1 or 2 on one of the weapon's own damage dice for an attack with a Battleaxe, Greataxe, Handaxe, Light Hammer, Maul, Warhammer, or War Pick, you can reroll the die, and you must use the new roll. (Extra dice from other features, such as Stampede or Sneak Attack, aren't rerolled.)
**The Locking.** Once per turn, when you Shove a creature with an Unarmed Strike made with your horns, the creature has Disadvantage on its saving throw.

peoples.name: Vorthani
peoples.hint: A Foursworn adds their Ascent.
peoples.tagline: Nine feet of patience with four arms and horns: the giant-kin monk-folk of the southern high peaks.

blocks.text: **Creature Type:** Humanoid
**Size:** Medium (about 8 to 10 feet tall)
**Speed:** 30 feet
As a Vorthani, you have these special traits.
**Four Arms.** Your upper arms are heavy and built for power; your lower arms are finer and built for precision.
Your lower arms can hold and manipulate objects, take the Utilize action, use tools, perform the Somatic and Material components of spells, and hold a Spellcasting Focus.
Your lower arms can't wield weapons or Shields, or make attacks.

Your lower arms count as free hands for loading ammunition (a bow's arrows, a crossbow's bolts), for spellcasting, and for holding, drawing, stowing, or handing over objects. They don't count as hands for wielding a weapon, for the Two-Handed or Versatile property, for holding a Shield, or for Grappling.
On each of your turns, you can interact with one extra object or feature of the environment for free.
**Powerful Build.** You have Advantage on any ability check you make to end the Grappled condition, and you count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity.
**Mountain Calm.** You have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Frightened condition.

**Fourfold Craft.** You have proficiency in the Insight skill and with one type of Artisan's Tools of your choice. When you craft an item with tools you're proficient with, you finish it in half the usual time.

**The Kindling (Level 3).** As a Bonus Action, you release the banked fire. For 1 minute, you have Advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws, and once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with an attack, you can deal extra damage to it equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.
*A General feat for level 4 or later, in place of another General feat.*
**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Strength, Constitution, or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
**Second Kindling.** You can use The Kindling twice before you finish a Long Rest.
**The Word as Contract.** You have Advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks you make to have someone accept your promise, and any Vorthani who hears it treats it as signed.

peoples.name: Warforged
peoples.hint: A warforged is named by whoever woke it, or for the work it does.
peoples.tagline: A made person of metal, stone, and wood, older than any people of the islands.

blocks.text: **Creature Type:** Humanoid
**Size:** Medium (about 5 to 7 feet tall) or Small (about 3 to 4 feet tall), chosen when you select this species
**Speed:** 30 feet
As a warforged, you have these special traits.

**Made Body.** You have Resistance to Poison damage and Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Poisoned condition. You don't need to eat, drink, or breathe, and magic can't put you to sleep. Healing works on you as it does on anyone.
**Watchful Rest.** You don't sleep. You can finish a Long Rest in 6 hours if you spend them still and at rest, and you stay aware of your surroundings the whole time.
**Plated.** You gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class.

**Heavy as an Anchor.** You don't float. In water you sink unless you succeed on a DC 15 Strength (Athletics) check at the start of each of your turns. Because you don't breathe, you can walk the bottom instead, and the sea floor is Difficult Terrain for you.
**The Work You Were Given.** You gain proficiency in one skill and with one tool of your choice: the work you were made for, or the first work you were woken to.

**Older Than the Islands.** You have Advantage on Intelligence checks you make to understand a mechanism, a ruin, or a working that was built before the peoples of the islands came. Sometimes you remember why it was built. Your Game Master tells you when.
*A General feat for level 4 or later, in place of another General feat.*
**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Strength, Constitution, or Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Built In.** Choose one tool you are proficient with. It is part of your body: it can't be taken from you, you don't need a free hand to use it, and you add double your Proficiency Bonus to ability checks you make with it.
**Bottom-Walker.** The sea floor is no longer Difficult Terrain for you, you have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet while under water, and you ignore the cold and pressure of the deep.

peoples.name: Cat-kin (tabaxi)
peoples.hint: Short, purring names. The byname counts the lives still owed to Mishri the Nine-Lived. Choose a homeland to get the tribe instead.
peoples.tagline: The tabaxi of other tables: quick, curious cat-folk of the southern ports, born owing nine lives to a luck spirit.

blocks.text: **Creature Type:** Humanoid
**Size:** Small (about 3 feet tall) or Medium (about 5 to 6 feet tall), chosen when you select this species
**Speed:** 30 feet, and a Climb Speed of 30 feet
As one of the cat-kin, you have these special traits.
**Darkvision.** You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

**Claws.** You can use your claws to make Unarmed Strikes. When you hit with them, the strike deals 1d6 + your Strength modifier Slashing damage, instead of the Bludgeoning damage normal for an Unarmed Strike.
**Burst.** When you move on your turn, you can double your Speed until the end of that turn. Once you do, you can't do so again until you move 0 feet on one of your turns.
**Roof-Born.** You gain proficiency in one of these skills: Acrobatics, Perception, or Stealth.

**Mishri's Count.** When you are reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 Hit Point instead. You can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest. Each time you use this trait, you have spent one of the lives you owe: count it down. You start play with up to eight left (your choice, and your byname). When the count reaches zero, this trait is gone, and Mishri is waiting.
*A General feat for level 4 or later, in place of another General feat.*
**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Dexterity or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
**On Your Feet.** When you fall, you reduce the damage by an amount equal to five times your character level, and you don't land Prone unless the fall reduces you to 0 Hit Points.
**Mishri Laughs.** When you use Mishri's Count, you also gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your character level, and you can move up to half your Speed at once without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
**A Life Found.** Once, when you take this feat, add one to your count.

peoples.name: Pride-kin (leonin)
peoples.hint: Open, rolling names, with the pride after. Choose a homeland to get a tribe instead.
peoples.tagline: The leonin of other tables: tall, maned folk of the southern grass, who judge and fight as one pride.

blocks.text: **Creature Type:** Humanoid
**Size:** Medium (about 6 to 7 feet tall)
**Speed:** 35 feet
As one of the pride-kin, you have these special traits.
**Darkvision.** You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

**Claws.** You can use your claws to make Unarmed Strikes. When you hit with them, the strike deals 1d6 + your Strength modifier Slashing damage, instead of the Bludgeoning damage normal for an Unarmed Strike.

**Roar.** As a Bonus Action, you roar. Each creature of your choice within 10 feet of you that can hear you must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 + your Constitution modifier + your Proficiency Bonus) or have the Frightened condition until the end of your next turn. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all uses when you finish a Long Rest.

**The Pride Stands.** While an ally who isn't Incapacitated is within 10 feet of you, you have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Frightened condition. When you use your Roar, each ally of your choice within 10 feet of you who can hear it is no longer Frightened.
**Voice of the Grass.** You gain proficiency in one of these skills: Athletics, Intimidation, Perception, or Survival.
*A General feat for level 4 or later, in place of another General feat.*
**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Strength, Constitution, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
**Carrying Voice.** The range of your Roar becomes 20 feet.
**The Pride Answers.** When you use your Roar, each ally of your choice within its range who can hear it gains Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

peoples.name: Ivory-kin (loxodon)
peoples.hint: Long, low names, with the one thing that ivory-kin remembers for the herd. Choose a homeland to get a tribe instead.
peoples.tagline: The loxodon of other tables: huge, grey, tusked folk who walk the long roads of the south and keep its memory.

blocks.text: **Creature Type:** Humanoid
**Size:** Medium (about 7 to 8 feet tall)
**Speed:** 30 feet
As one of the ivory-kin, you have these special traits.
**Thick Hide.** When you aren't wearing armor, your base Armor Class is 12 + your Constitution modifier. You can use a Shield and keep this benefit.
**Powerful Build.** You have Advantage on any ability check you make to end the Grappled condition. You also count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity.

**Trunk.** Your trunk can lift, drop, hold, push, or pull an object or a creature, open or close a door or container, or grapple someone. It can lift a weight in pounds up to five times your Strength score. It can't wield weapons or Shields or do anything that needs fine tools. You can breathe through it while the rest of you is under water, and you have Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) and Wisdom (Survival) checks that rely on smell.
**Slow to Anger.** You have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Charmed or Frightened condition.

**The Remembering.** You gain proficiency in the History skill, and you can recall exactly anything you have seen or heard within the past month. Choose, with your Game Master, the one memory you carry for your herd: a road, a drought, a debt, a lineage. When you make an Intelligence check to recall something that memory covers, you can treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10.
*A General feat for level 4 or later, in place of another General feat.*
**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Strength, Constitution, or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
**Unmoved.** When an effect would push or pull you or give you the Prone condition, you can take a Reaction to remain where you are, standing.
**Stand Behind Me.** When a creature you can see makes a ranged attack against an ally within 5 feet of you, you can take a Reaction to step into the way and impose Disadvantage on the attack roll.
**The Herd Remembers.** You can carry a second memory for your herd, with the same benefit as the first.

peoples.name: Centaurs
peoples.hint: Striding names, with the herd after. Choose a homeland to get a tribe instead.
peoples.tagline: Four-legged folk of the open grass, who count their wealth in the distance they have run.

blocks.text: **Creature Type:** Humanoid
**Size:** Medium (about 6 to 7 feet tall, and longer than a horse is tall)
**Speed:** 40 feet
As a centaur, you have these special traits.

**Hooves.** You can use your hooves to make Unarmed Strikes. When you hit with them, the strike deals 1d6 + your Strength modifier Bludgeoning damage, instead of the damage normal for an Unarmed Strike.
**Charge.** If you move at least 30 feet straight toward a target and then hit it with a melee weapon attack on the same turn, you can make one attack with your Hooves against it as a Bonus Action.

**Four-Legged Build.** You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift. Any climb that needs hands and feet, a ship's ladder or rigging above all, costs you 4 extra feet for each foot you move. A Medium or smaller creature can ride you only if you are willing, and by custom you are not.

**The Long Run.** You can travel 12 hours in a day before a forced march begins to wear on you, instead of 8, and you can travel at a Fast pace without the usual penalty to Wisdom (Perception) checks.
**Every Well.** You can't become lost by nonmagical means on a route you have traveled before, and you always know where the nearest fresh water you have drunk from lies.
**Herd-Raised.** You gain proficiency in one of these skills: Animal Handling, Medicine, Nature, or Survival.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Strength, Constitution, or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

qualities.name: Far

qualities.name: Weathered

qualities.name: Turning

qualities.name: Swift

curios: A Bit buys a fishbread, a saltknot, a mug of small ale, or a cup of brightleaf.
A laborer earns three Bits a day. An Anchor is their month, and an Orsal is their year.
A soldier’s sword costs fifteen Anchors: more than a year of a field hand’s life.
The week is ten days long and is called a Cycle. It never starts over, not even for the Still Days.
The Still Days are five days that belong to no god. Debts pause, courts close, and every fae bargain comes due.
Never whistle for wind aboard ship. It brings too much.
The first drop of every bottle opened at sea goes over the rail.
Greet the sea-folk in song. Any song will do. Effort counts.
Bare cold iron is an insult to the sea-folk. Wrap it or leave it in the boat.
About one Kalvatari in forty depends on a sea-pact.
The Iron Swan is the only steamship in the world, and no Council has dared put a price on her captain.

Every Hunter’s Sigil is forged in one place: the Sigil-Forge of the Goldwind Lodge.
A Sigil carried by anyone but its bearer makes them ill. None of it kills.
The battle of the Kraken’s Maw lasted sixteen hours.
The Old Shells answer three questions in a generation, and nobody can predict which three.
The Veil of Shadows has played the same play every night for about a hundred and forty years.
